mentions.name: Cyclonauts
mentions.description: A Strava addon that maps users' cycling activity data against the OpenStreetMap catalogue to generate exploration statistics, making bike commutes more fun.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on Cyclonauts (https://cyclonauts.net), an addon for Strava to make your commute more fun.

It maps your cycling activity data against the OpenStreetMap catalogue to generate all kinds of exploration statistics.
